result.instructions: Tools for LiveAgent, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open tickets are waiting for a reply in the billing department?"; "Show me the messages and history of ticket 1024, and whether its SLA is breached."; "Which agents are in the Tier 2 group, and what departments are they in?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes LiveAgent data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run liveagent_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run liveagent_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run liveagent_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. liveagent_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: liveagent_create_ticket
tools.title: Create a ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket for a customer. By default it sends no email to the customer (doNotSendMail is Y); set it to N only when the user asks to notify the customer. POST /tickets.

useridentifier.description: Sender identifier that the vendor's create-ticket body requires (see the vendor reference).

departmentid.description: Department id the ticket goes to (from liveagent_list_departments).

message.description: First message text of the ticket.

doNotSendMail.description: Y = do not email the customer (default). N = email the customer.

tools.name: liveagent_update_ticket
tools.title: Update a ticket
tools.description: Change a ticket's status, department, agent, subject or tags. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /tickets/{ticketId}.

status.description: Ticket status code (I, N, T, P, R or X).

tags.description: Replace the tag list with these tags.
